intended_use: Decision-support vulnerability scoring on a 0-100 continuous index. Not a deterministic prediction of individual default.
limitations: Scores represent vulnerability likelihood distributions, not individual borrower default certainties.
Macro-level satellite observations (NDVI) may exhibit pixel-level lag or cloud contamination.
Ground-level micro-drainage or borrower-specific irrigation assets are not captured in gridded telemetry.
Decisions must incorporate field officer validation and human-in-the-loop review.
